title: NgDoc Vite development server
description: Serves an Angular application with the Vite development server and the NgDoc Vite engine.

configFile.description: The Vite configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

host.description: The host to listen on. Defaults to the Vite configuration's server.host.

port.description: The port to listen on. Defaults to the Vite configuration's server.port.
